source: lifted from finance repo best_config_id=8; semantics re-mapped to arxiv SyllogismRetriever

mapping_notes.retrieval_depth: top_k in SyllogismRetriever.retrieve() — per-paper Stage 8 loop iterations; pgvector candidate pool stays at best_retriever_params.top_k
mapping_notes.reranking: NLI LLM judge (Stage 3) + EntailmentRanker 3-way blend (Stage 5) — already implemented
mapping_notes.context_budget: chars of prior paper's angle injected into next paper's Stage 8 prompt (running_context accumulation)
mapping_notes.planning_depth: single-shot decision tree call — already 1, no change
mapping_notes.verification_passes: no self-critique loops — already 0, no change
mapping_notes.temperature: Ollama options.temperature for all Stage 8 calls
mapping_notes.top_p: Ollama options.top_p — added to all Stage 8 payload options
mapping_notes.frequency_penalty: mapped to Ollama repeat_penalty=1.3 (multiplicative, not additive)
mapping_notes.abstention_policy: papers with nli_scores[pid] < abstention_tau skipped in Stage 8 synthesis; always keep >=1 paper
mapping_notes.geo_alpha: entailment_weight in EntailmentRanker (LLM judge selection quality)
mapping_notes.selection_prec: retrieval_weight in EntailmentRanker (initial retrieval rank precision)
mapping_notes.confidence_bonus: confidence_weight in EntailmentRanker (cross-encoder max entailment prob — nli_scores, previously computed but unused in blend)
